source_binding: The probe, exporter, controller and CMake wiring were committed before the authorized original run; strict export and the core replay used the committed source. This validation file and the results README are a documentation follow-up.

observed.note: The request is one window action changing both axes; the observed NAWS sequence is recorded and not assumed atomic, and this single run does not establish general behavior.

core_replay.scope: Fixed source/protocol inputs: initial body, resize_preserving(14,61), CUP(7;2)+DQ+DSR, resize_preserving(20,91), final DSR. Pre-write retained row remains full; the edited row materializes to the observed 62-character form; DSR 7;4 both times. No production change.

limitations: One fixed 75 B ASCII direct-Telnet sample; main screen only; no alternate frame, Unicode, other sizes/orders, continuous output, selection/Find, full grid/style, ConPTY transport, physical presentation or performance.
The observed original scrolled by 5 and clipped the written source row to 62 characters; no internal history-row count or scroll model is inferred.
The one NAWS event count/order is recorded for this run only; a single window request is not assumed to be an atomic two-axis transport event in general.
The old six-stage B/CD native-sync failure is not explained by this WindTerm UI observation and is not relaxed; ConPTY native-grid reflow after a simultaneous change remains unobserved.
The product retained-body direction remains the confirmed direction; this record is an original observation, not a claim of WindTerm equality or a rewrite of the confirmed intentional difference.
